title: Personal Services Plan Statement Terms — Due Day, Grace, Fees and Dispute Window
content:
The personal services statement of the Personal Services Plan is governed by six figures, identical on every tier: the day of the month on which the statement falls due, the calendar days of grace after the due day before a late fee may be assessed, the late fee, the past-due amount below which no late fee is assessed, the fee for a returned payment, and the calendar days after the posting date of a charge or hours draw within which it may be disputed.

| Tier | Statement due day | Grace (calendar days) | Late fee (USD) | No late fee below a past-due amount of (USD) | Returned payment fee (USD) | Dispute window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 1 | 10 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 1 | 10 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 1 | 10 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 1 | 10 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 1 | 10 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 1 | 10 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |

## In short

The statement falls due on the 1st; grace runs 10 calendar days; the late fee is 25.00 USD and none is assessed on a past-due amount below 50.00 USD; a returned payment carries 35.00 USD; and a charge or hours draw may be disputed within 60 calendar days of its posting date.
